international.title: Foo Fighters interrupt Sydney concert to pay tribute to Beaconsfield miner Todd Russell
international.summary: Dave Grohl tells Sydney crowd Russell, whose death was announced this week, was a ‘big’ hero of his A solemn moment has broken up an otherwise raucous Foo Fighters’ Australian concert as the band’s frontman made a lengthy on-stage tribute to Beaconsfield survivor Todd Russell. The US band are touring Australia for the 16th time in their 32-year history and Tuesday night’s Sydney show coincided with the news of Russell’s death at the age of 54 . Continue reading...
